objective: Implement the provider-neutral Day-1 payment, cash, refund, deposit, and settlement runtime defined by PAY.CONTRACT.1 while retaining the existing external payment processor and preserving Invoice and Accounting ownership.

repository.name: ACP-Enterprise
repository.start_rule: fetch origin and create an isolated worktree from current origin/customer-management-v1

prohibited_paths: backend/app/invoicing/** except consumption of accepted public commands/contracts
backend/app/accounting/** except consumption of accepted public contracts
persistence_owner: Payments owns intents, attempts, verified receipts, sanitized provider evidence, refund aggregates, receipt-availability evidence, deposits, settlements, reconciliation exceptions, idempotency, webhook receipts, and Accounting posting receipts. Invoicing owns AR applications/unapplications; Accounting owns journals, mappings, periods, controls, and statements.

processor_boundary.adapter: provider-neutral port with exactly one configured existing-processor adapter at activation
processor_boundary.tokenization: processor-hosted or direct-to-processor; ACP stores opaque references only
processor_boundary.secrets: approved runtime secret facility only; never database, API, log, event, or repository
processor_boundary.webhooks: verify raw body signature, timestamp tolerance, provider, merchant account, and secret version before parsing or mutation

migration.parent_rule: immediately before integration, descend from the then-current single authoritative head after INVOICE.1-3.ACCEL
migration.reparent_rule: mechanical re-parenting is allowed only before application and only when DDL, data, runtime, and downgrade semantics remain unchanged

required_invariants: verified capture is the only source of a receipt
exact command replay returns the original result and contradictory replay fails
ambiguous processor outcomes reconcile before retry and never create a new provider idempotency identity
captured amount equals available plus applied plus refunded plus disputed-or-reversed amount
Payments never mutates Invoice AR evidence and uses accepted application/unapplication commands
overpayments remain unapplied and are never implicit revenue or customer credit
refunds never exceed verified refundable balance and applied refunds require compensating unapplication
settlement components reconcile exactly to provider net payout and accepted bank/clearing controls
provider fees never reduce receipt or AR principal
Company, Branch, Customer, merchant, provider, and currency scope is enforced
financial evidence is append-only and missing evidence is never zero
Accounting posted state requires an Accounting posting receipt
validation: provider adapter contract tests with a deterministic fake; no live processor calls
raw-body webhook signature, timestamp, merchant, rotation, tamper, and replay tests
intent, authorization, capture, decline, failure, ambiguity, cancellation, and expiry lifecycle tests
concurrent retry, canonical digest, provider idempotency, and duplicate-charge tests
verified receipt, partial application, unapplication, overpayment, and Invoice isolation tests
refund partial/full/failure/late-event and applied-refund compensation tests
deposit, undeposited-funds, clearing, fee, dispute, settlement, and variance tests
append-only evidence and deterministic projection rebuild tests
Company, Branch, Customer, provider merchant, and currency isolation tests
Business Event and Accounting posting-receipt seam tests
API and responsive frontend workflow tests if frontend is implemented
affected Invoice, Accounting, Customer, Job, Platform, and Communications regressions
fresh Alembic upgrade, downgrade/re-upgrade, drift detection, and exactly one head
Ruff, MyPy, ESLint, TypeScript typecheck/build where applicable, git diff --check, and focused secret scan

environment_gates.preview: separate owner authorization with non-production processor credentials and synthetic transactions only
environment_gates.production: separate Production authorization after Finance control review, ACC.IC.1, reconciliation rehearsal, and go/no-go gates
environment_gates.processor_activation: separate owner authorization after credential, webhook, merchant, and mapping evidence
environment_gates.real_transactions: prohibited during implementation and automated validation

completion: runtime implementation and validation pass against deterministic provider fakes
fail-closed activation gates remain explicit for missing processor and Finance inputs
one exact-boundary commit is normally pushed
local and remote are synchronized with clean tree and empty index
